note: Pat's Point is a campground of gravel sites on a grassy peninsula in Keyhole Reservoir, ~6 mi N of I-90 exit 165. Site PP19 at the tip and PP22 on the southwest side sit on open grass about 15-25 m from the water; the other lake-side sites look through a band of shrubs and trees. The park's electric sites are at Tatanka and Coulter Bay. --Claude
